description: The study's conditions. inputs: T title and year, D transcript, V frames (the experiment's frame set unless `frames` is set), R on-screen text, A sounds. transform window_only keeps the cited evidence ± pad_s; cut_evidence and cut_placebo are described in pipeline/conditions.py.

q.description: Question only: no title and no film

tdvra.description: Whole film: title + transcript + frames + on-screen text + sounds

w_tr.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + on-screen text

w_tdv.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + frames

w_tdr.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + on-screen text

w_tda.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + sounds

w_tvr.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + frames + on-screen text

w_tva.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + frames + sounds

w_tra.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + on-screen text + sounds

w_tdvr.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + frames + on-screen text

w_tdva.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + frames + sounds

w_tvra.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + frames + on-screen text + sounds

w_tdvra.description: Excerpts (cited evidence ± 60 s): title + transcript + frames + on-screen text + sounds

tdvra_cut.description: Whole film, all inputs, with the cited evidence (± 10 s) removed and every transcript line (± 1 s), screen of text and sound label that states the answer (numbers up to 12 excepted)

tdvra_placebo.description: Whole film, all inputs, with stretches of the same lengths as in tdvra_cut removed away from the evidence and from every mention of the answer

tdv_fullframes.description: Whole film: title + transcript + frames with the on-screen text visible (no text track)
